question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Austere
solution: The correct answer is **"Genial."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Austere"** means severe or stern in manner or appearance. (कठोर/सादगीपूर्ण) • **Example**: *Despite their wealth, they lead an **austere**__ life. * • **"Genial"** is the opposite of **austere.** • It means** **meaning friendly and cheerful. (प्रसन्‍नचित्त और मित्रवत) __ • **Example**: *The teacher has a **genial**__ manner.* • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Affordable**, is not an antonym of austere. It means reasonably priced or within one's financial means. (आर्थिक पहुँच के भीतर) • **Stiff**, is not an antonym of austere. It means rigid or inflexible. ((वस्‍तु, काग़ज़ आदि) सख्‍़त, कड़ा और न झुकने या मुड़ने वाला) • **Gruff**, is not an antonym of austere. It means rough or blunt in the manner of speech. ((व्‍यक्ति या स्‍वर) रूखा और कठोर) 35:Tc5b, The correct answer is **"Central."**
